title: 7 Points to Tsinghua but 10 Points to 清华? Assessing Agentic Large Language Models in Multilingual National Bias

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs in multiple languages to rate and recommend options (universities, relocation cities, and travel destinations) from various countries, and analyzing the statistical divergence of the assigned scores to identify preferences for specific nations based on the language used.
Comparing model evaluation scores and recommendation behaviors across different languages when the advisory prompt is varied to simulate male versus female applicant personas.
